cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "=== procs ==="; ps -eo pid,etime,cmd | grep -E "git |vps_|rev-list|cat-file" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-150
echo "=== crontab ==="; sudo crontab -l 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200; echo "-- ubuntu:"; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200
echo "=== lock files in code ==="; grep -rnE "LOCK_FILE\s*=|\.lock" scripts/vps_pipeline.py scripts/vps_satellite_pipeline.py scripts/vps_ai_pipeline.py 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-160 | head -12
echo "=== remote ==="; git remote -v | sed -E 's#://[^@]*@#://***@#'
echo "=== status (short) ==="; git status --short | head -15; git status --short | wc -l
echo "=== ignored sizes ==="; git status --ignored --short | grep '^!!' | head -20
echo "=== local config ==="; git config --local --list | sed -E 's#://[^@]*@#://***@#'
echo "=== disk free ==="; df -h / | tail -1
